A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck eastern Indonesia, resulting in at least 47 fatalities, according to the National Disaster Mitigation Agency (BNPB). Rescue efforts face challenges as landslides block access to Nagekeo, near the epicenter. Tsunami waves under 1 meter were reported, prompting a temporary warning.

Earthquake in Indonesia kills 38; Catholic festival cancelled

At least 38 people have died and thousands have been displaced after a powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck Indonesia’s predominantly Catholic island of Flores. The Diocese of Labuan Bajo canceled the closing celebrations of the Golo Koe Maria Assumpta Nusantara Festival, while a major priestly formation celebration in Ledalero was moved outdoors after earthquake damage made the chapel and reception hall unsafe.
